name: DaVinci Resolve
description: Drive DaVinci Resolve from chat: timelines, media, grading, Fusion and rendering
long_description:
Exposes DaVinci Resolve's scripting API as MCP tools.

This extension is a thin bridge: the server itself runs inside DaVinci Resolve, which is what lets it work on the free edition as well as Studio. Before using it, open a project in Resolve and run **Workspace > Scripts > MCP Server**. The extension then talks to that server over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8765.

Set RESOLVE_MCP_URL if you serve on a different host or port.
